findings.description: ChatWidget gains remote_on_cancel but the plan did not cover widget-replacement lifecycle. App::replace_chat_widget (session_lifecycle.rs:336) explicitly transfers remote_connection to the replacement widget; without an analogous transfer of remote_on_cancel an in-flight onboard becomes uncancellable across thread-switch/resume/fork.
findings.resolution: Added session_lifecycle.rs to Files to Modify with a remote_on_cancel transfer beside the remote_connection line; added an AC and a Risk-Areas bullet. Verified against source: session_lifecycle.rs:336.

findings.description: The 'promptly' cancellation criterion is not measurable.
findings.resolution: Abort-path AC now bounds the assertion in tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), join) after cancel(), proving the poll does not wait for expires_in.

findings.description: File paths are ambiguous about repo root: code paths are relative to the codex submodule, not codexu root.
findings.resolution: Added an explicit Target-repo+cwd note: all code paths are relative to D:/harness-efforts/codexu/codex/ (a codex-submodule worktree); the cargo/just workspace is codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs.

findings.description: The dependency rationale 'TUI cannot name tokio::sync types' is inaccurate; tui already uses tokio::sync::mpsc via Cargo feature unification.
findings.resolution: Corrected the rationale: tokio::sync IS usable in tui via feature unification; Option A is chosen for cohesion + zero Cargo edits, not because tui 'cannot' name the types.

findings.description: Patch-surface invariant test (happy_seam_invariants.rs) not listed as a modification target; invariant_60 only checks run_self_onboard/has_credentials/ensure_running and would not enforce the new cancel seam.
findings.resolution: Added happy_seam_invariants.rs to Files to Modify with a new invariant_61 asserting the cancel seam markers + an AC. Verified against source: happy_seam_invariants.rs:287-320.

findings.description: The sender-drop re-entry cancellation behavior was claimed but not tested.
findings.resolution: /remote on now explicitly cancels any existing handle before replacing it; added a re-entry test AC asserting sender-drop/replace yields Err(Cancelled).

findings.description: 'Each new upstream-canonical line carries // SANDBOX PATCH: remote_session' is too literal for multi-line Rust blocks.
findings.resolution: Reworded to require each new upstream-canonical seam/block to be covered by an adjacent marker, enforced by happy_seam_invariants (invariant_61).

findings.description: Feature request asks the abort-path test to assert a cancellation notice, but the plan left notice-mapping as an untested TUI requirement.
findings.resolution: run_self_onboard now emits a cancellation OnboardNotice through the sink before returning Err(Cancelled), so the overlay abort-path test asserts the notice hermetically.

findings.description: The poll_for_token restructure mitigation ('keep body intact inside the select arm') was misleading: the loop body has early returns that would break if wrapped in an inner async{} inside select!.
findings.resolution: Switched to the minimal shape (top-of-loop is_cancelled() check + select! on the sleep await only), leaving the retry/return ladder untouched; added an explicit do-NOT-wrap warning and a Risk bullet citing the early-return line numbers.

findings.description: Verification commands omit the working directory (the Rust workspace is under codex/external/repos/codex-patched/codex-rs).
findings.resolution: ACs now state the cwd for cargo check --workspace, cargo test, and just fmt/fix.

findings.description: Relying only on watch sender-drop for re-entry cancellation is less clear than explicitly cancelling the existing handle before replacing it.
findings.resolution: /remote on now explicitly .cancel()s any existing remote_on_cancel before storing the new handle (sender-drop remains a tested backstop).
